description: Source code for generating and managing AI agents, including classes for Claude, Opencode, Copilot, and VSCode generators, with functions for initializing repositories, writing/deleting files, and configuring agent specifications.

classes.name: ClaudeGenerator
classes.description: Handles initialization and agent specification generation for Claude AI agents.

classes.name: OpencodeGenerator

classes.name: CopilotGenerator

classes.name: VSCodeGenerator
